issue.title: just check fails at lint (mypy): KillAndEditLastLaunchMixin's _current_group_key/current_attempt_number conflict with every AceApp mixin
issue.description: just check's mypy gate fails on master (confirmed via git stash on commit b93a1894d, before any unrelated changes) with 25 errors in src/sase/ace/tui/app.py. KillAndEditLastLaunchMixin (added by commit 4394da2e1 'feat(ace): add kill-and-edit-last-launch keymap (,X) for resolved-branch relaunch') declares _current_group_key with a type incompatible with the same attribute declared on every other AceApp mixin (AgentsMixinCore, AgentFoldPersistenceMixin, AgentGroupFoldingMixin, AgentStructuralFoldingMixin, AgentPanelFoldingMixin, AgentGroupingMixin, AgentKillMixin, AgentKillActionFlowMixin, AgentMarkNavigationMixin, AgentPanelsMixin, AgentPanelNavigationMixin, AgentNavigationOrderMixin, AgentSelectionMixin, AgentUnreadNavigationMixin, AgentRevivalMixin, AgentReviveStateMixin, AgentDisplayMixin, AgentNeighborMixin, PanelRefreshStateMixin, PanelPatchMixin, AgentFooterDisplayMixin, AgentInfoDisplayMixin, EventWidgetHandlersMixin, NavigationMixinBase), and its current_attempt_number signature (int | None) overrides a supertype method whose signature mypy reports as None. Discovered while implementing sase-w3.3 (tri-state link-follow coordinator); my diff never touches app.py or KillAndEditLastLaunchMixin.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: A mypy structural-typing error is deterministic, not intermittent: the same 25 errors reproduce identically on a clean git-stash of master (commit b93a1894d) with no working-tree changes, so this is a confirmed true failure introduced by 4394da2e1, not a rerun-dependent flake.

payload.entry: Fixed inside epic sase-w8 and verified by its land agent. Commit 51c3fbcd5 (sase-w8.3) added the missing class-level annotations to KillAndEditLastLaunchMixin (_current_group_key: tuple[str, ...] | None, current_idx: int, current_attempt_number: int | None) at src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agent_workflow/_kill_last_launch.py:95-98, so the mixin now matches AceApp instead of inferring None-only types from the reveal assignments. Verified on clean master 82dc1e224 in a freshly 'just install'ed workspace venv: .venv/bin/mypy reports 'Success: no issues found in 4004 source files', and 'just lint' passes the mypy gate along with ruff, feature flags, pyscripts, test waits, changelog, terminology, symvision and toobig. The same fix is recorded on epic bead sase-w8 note #1.
